abstract.p: Compositions and methods are described for the delivery of therapeutic products to the retina/vitreal humour in the eyes of human subjects to treat pathologies of the eye, involving, for example, recombinant viral vectors such as recombinant adeno-associated virus (rAAV) vectors.
